summary: Compare pressure probes at the same depth in differently shaped stationary containers.
objective: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
intent_signals: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
Compare pressure probes at the same depth in differently shaped stationary containers.
example_prompts: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of hydrostatic pressure with depth and pressure rulers.
negative_signals: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.
not_for: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.

entities.name: Vessel cutaways
entities.guidance: Build a narrow cylinder and broad stepped vessel with clear inner walls and horizontal surfaces; keep the liquid explicitly at rest.

entities.name: Pressure probes
entities.guidance: Place small probe disks at selected equal depths and draw normal pressure arrows using a shared pressure-to-length scale.

entities.name: Depth and pressure rulers
entities.guidance: Show h from the free surface, rho, g and separate gauge/absolute readouts; units are meters, kg/m^3 and pascals.

state_contract.model: Static liquid with constant density rho>0, uniform g>0, common absolute surface pressure p0>=0 and depth h>=0 below each free surface. Gauge pressure rho*g*h; absolute pressure adds p0.
state_contract.authority: Density, gravity, free-surface height and probe depth own all pressures. Container shape affects the display geometry, not this point-pressure relation.
actions: Drag probes vertically within the liquid.
Link probes to equal depth across vessels.

invariants: Equal depths with the same liquid and surface pressure give equal pressure regardless of vessel width.
Gauge pressure is zero at the free surface.
Pressure arrows act normal to the local probe face; their lengths do not represent liquid speed.
motion_guidance: Probe dragging is an inspection action; no sloshing or flow is generated by moving a diagram probe.
If surface height changes, recompute depth from the new surface before updating pressure.
known_limits: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.
This point-pressure model does not by itself compute total force on a curved wall.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Pressure in a stationary constant-density liquid increases by rho*g*h below its free surface under uniform gravity.
claims.scope: Static liquid with the same imposed surface pressure and density.

object_craft.structure: Build a narrow cylinder and broad stepped vessel with clear inner walls and horizontal surfaces; keep the liquid explicitly at rest.
object_craft.material: Translucent liquid and matte vessel cutaway edges; pressure arrows and depth rulers use opaque marks independent of refraction.

physical_contract.scope: Static analytic pressure field; no flow simulation.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
driving: Uniform gravity and liquid depth determine pressure.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.
